items.title: Salesforce Vs. ServiceNow: You Can Trust Both Following The Recent Drop
items.summary: Both software giants promised agentic AI would fuel their next chapter, and investors answered with a sell-off. One company guards the data agents need, the other polices the agents themselves. Which bet has Wall Street underpricing?

items.title: Wall Street Analysts Believe Salesforce (CRM) Could Rally 26.34%: Here's is How to Trade
items.summary: The mean of analysts' price targets for Salesforce (CRM) points to a 26.3% upside in the stock. While this highly sought-after metric has not proven reasonably effective, strong agreement among analysts in raising earnings estimates does indicate an upside in the stock.

items.title: TWLO Declines 12% Since Q3 Results: Is This a Buy-the-Dip Opportunity?
items.summary: Twilio shares have lost 12% since Q3 results, but rising profits, record cash flow and AI opportunities are likely to make the recent dip an attractive buying opportunity.

items.title: S&P cuts Salesforce to ’A’ on rising acquisition debt and buybacks
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings downgraded Salesforce Inc (NYSE:CRM) to 'A' from 'A+', pointing to an increasingly aggressive capital allocation strategy characterized by debt-funded shareholder returns and large-scale acquisitions. The ratings agency highlighted that recent dealmaking, alongside a $25 billion debt-financed share repurchase program, has pushed pro forma net debt-to-EBITDA above its previous 2x downgrade threshold.

items.title: Salesforce Stock Has Only Done This Twice Before. Here's What History Suggests Happens Next.
items.summary: Salesforce's two earlier 50% drawdowns eventually rewarded patient buyers. Its history offers encouragement, but today's business still has to earn a recovery.

items.title: Salesforce (CRM) Moves to Strong Buy: Rationale Behind the Upgrade
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) has been upgraded to a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), reflecting growing optimism about the company's earnings prospects. This might drive the stock higher in the near term.
